steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.narration: Let's start by viewing the main dashboard and confirming the system is ready to use.
steps.point_out: The top-right badge should show 'Ready' in green, indicating the backend is available.

steps.title: View the Data Manager
steps.narration: Now let's visit the Data Manager to see the backfill interface and current dataset status.
steps.point_out: You should see a 'Start a fetch / backfill job' panel with date fields and a 'Run history' section showing prior backfill attempts.

steps.title: Check the dataset coverage panel
steps.narration: The Data Manager shows key dataset statistics. Look at the coverage metrics to understand what date ranges are already snapshotted.
steps.point_out: You should see numeric values for 'Backfill gaps' and other coverage metrics—not a blank or error state.

steps.title: Navigate to the Stocks section
steps.narration: Let's verify that navigation between pages remains fast and responsive, even after this backend iteration.
steps.point_out: The page should load promptly and display the stocks list.

steps.title: View a stock detail page
steps.narration: Opening a specific stock's page should load quickly with only the data it needs.
steps.point_out: The page should show the stock symbol and relevant data within the expected load time.

steps.title: Check the Backtest results page
steps.narration: The Backtest page displays pre-computed evidence. This iteration ensures it always serves from storage rather than recomputing on request.
steps.point_out: You should see 'Forward-tested evidence' and populated evidence values—never a blank loading screen.

steps.title: Return to Data Manager to view background compute
steps.narration: Let's check the background compute panel to confirm the system properly discloses any in-flight compute activity.
steps.point_out: If any background processes are running, the panel should list them with elapsed time and progress—never silently omit them.

steps.title: Confirm the readiness badge remains stable
steps.narration: Throughout this tour, the top-bar badge should have stayed responsive and visible. This is the key reliability property this iteration verifies.
steps.point_out: The readiness badge in the top-right corner should display either 'Ready' or an explicit status—never blank or stuck on 'Checking...'.
